author: Milet__
quote: The game has some charming moments and a memorable soundtrack, but it falls short in several important areas. I expected full voice acting throughout the cutscenes and character interactions, yet most dialogue still relies on text, with only a handful of voiced lines. The Ocarina is another missed opportunity: despite the freedom it seems to promise, playing different notes never really feels like creating your own melodies, as the game simply triggers predetermined tunes. Loading screens between areas also interrupt the exploration, while the limited number of NPCs makes the world feel rather empty. It still has the charm of the original, but the overall experience feels underwhelming
